name: lmrobdetLinTest
title: Robust likelihood ratio test for linear hypotheses
description: This function computes a robust likelihood ratio test for linear hypotheses.

arguments.description: an `lmrobdetMM` or `lmrobM` object with the fit corresponding to the complete model

an `lmrobdetMM` or `lmrobM` object with the fit corresponding to the model
restricted under the null linear hypothesis.

value.description: p-value based on the F distribution
p-value based on the chi-squared distribution

examples_r:
data(oats)
cont <- lmrobdet.control(bb = 0.5, efficiency = 0.85, family = "bisquare")
oats1M <- lmrobM(response1 ~ variety+block, control=cont, data=oats)
oats1M_var <- lmrobM(response1 ~ block, control=cont, data=oats)
( anov1M_var <- rob.linear.test(oats1M, oats1M_var) )
